metadata_only_resources.name: MultiHop-RAG benchmark (dataset + reference RAG code)
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: No licence file in the upstream repository at the check date, so no redistribution right exists. Files downloaded in a first pass were deleted during the licence audit.
metadata_only_resources.access_requirements: Public read access; author permission needed to redistribute.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: RULER synthetic multi-hop generators (Apache-2.0) under resources/code-examples/ruler/

metadata_only_resources.name: arXiv preprint PDFs (all catalogued papers)
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: Two independent blockers: (1) this sandbox could not download binaries from arxiv.org (only read text); (2) most arXiv papers are distributed under the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence, which does not grant third-party redistribution. arXiv papers found inside permissively-licensed repositories inherit the PAPER licence, not the repository licence, so they were not copied either.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: CC BY 4.0 Google LLM Tuning Playbook (resources/documentation/tuning-playbook/) and CC BY-SA 4.0 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 PDF (resources/documentation/owasp-llm-top10/)

metadata_only_resources.name: Hugging Face model and dataset cards (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.x, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, embedding/reranker/OCR weights)
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: huggingface.co was not reachable for download from this sandbox, and model weights must not be downloaded without explicit approval (assignment safety boundary). Model licences also differ per model (Apache-2.0, Llama community licence, OpenRAIL-M, custom) and must be verified on the card itself.
metadata_only_resources.access_requirements: Free account for gated models; some weights require accepting a licence on the card page
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: Upstream code licences for marker/surya including the modified OpenRAIL-M MODEL_LICENSE (resources/licenses/marker/, resources/licenses/surya/)

metadata_only_resources.name: Hosted-API pricing, quota and terms pages (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Together, Fireworks, OpenRouter, HF Inference Endpoints)
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: Commercial terms pages change frequently and are not licensed for redistribution; a stale copy is worse than a link. Summarised in workstreams/13 with the check date and a mandatory re-verification step.

metadata_only_resources.name: mlfinlab (Hudson & Thames) — proprietary implementations of Advances in Financial Machine Learning methods
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: Proprietary "Copyright Protection Notice and Licensing Agreement" (repo last pushed 2023-10-02, licence detected as NOASSERTION). No redistribution right; nothing was collected.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: MIT-licensed ml4trading notebooks/scripts (resources/code-examples/ml4t/) covering labelling, MFE/MAE, signal evaluation, IC inference and multiple testing

metadata_only_resources.name: pandas-ta (twopirllc/pandas-ta) — original indicator library
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: The upstream slug returned HTTP 404 through the GitHub API on 2026-10-14 (repository removed, renamed or made private). Only community forks were resolvable.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: MIT-licensed fork xgboosted/pandas-ta-classic metadata + PyPI snapshots (resources/documentation/_pypi-metadata/pandas-ta-classic.json)

metadata_only_resources.name: Books: Advances in Financial Machine Learning (López de Prado); Machine Learning for Trading (Jansen, print edition); Building LLM Powered Applications
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: Copyrighted commercial books. Copying whole books or chapters is explicitly out of scope for this assignment.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: The MIT-licensed companion code repository stefan-jansen/machine-learning-for-trading (selected scripts bundled)

metadata_only_resources.name: HELMET long-context evaluation suite — exact arXiv identifier not verified
metadata_only_resources.paper: arXiv identifier NOT verified in this session
metadata_only_resources.reason_not_bundled: arXiv id 2409.12181 was queried and resolved to a DIFFERENT paper ("A Controlled Study on Long Context Extension and Generalization in LLMs", Lu et al.), so the commonly cited HELMET identifier was not confirmed. The MIT-licensed repository code was bundled instead; the paper link must be re-derived from the repository README before citing.
metadata_only_resources.lawful_alternative_bundled: HELMET README.md, CHANGELOG.md, data.py, eval.py, arguments.py, model_utils.py, config YAMLs

licence_audit.method: Downloaded every root licence file for each upstream repository and read it; GitHub SPDX detection was treated as a hint only and overridden where the bundled text disagreed.
not_collected_by_policy: Paul Graham essay text (bundled upstream in needle-in-a-haystack and RULER)
